films.title: 复活男
films.synopsis: 在面试中数度落选的求职者石焕（具教焕 饰），即使正处在人生最失意的时刻，身边仍有挚友英夏（姜其永 饰）的毒舌相劝，以及妹妹艺琳（金诗雅 饰）的始终支持。然而在某天夜里，石焕突然遭到神秘陌生人袭击，当场失去性命。没想到，死亡72小时之后，他竟奇迹般地再度睁开了眼睛！石焕这才得知，自己拥有一种“无论死去多少次，都能再度复活”的特殊能力。就在他还没弄清楚究竟发生什么事时，一位神秘男子（申承浩 饰）却已经悄悄盯上了他。随着神秘男子展开步步进逼的追杀，石焕也逐渐发现，每一次的死亡，都将让自己变得更加强大。究竟，是谁想置他于死地？而这个“死得越多，变得越强”的能力，又将把他带向什么样的命运？一场赌上性命的疯狂反击，即将展开。 影片改编自同名网络漫画。
films.synopsisEn: Job seeker Seok-hwan (Koo Kyo-hwan), who has repeatedly failed at interviews, finds himself at the lowest point in life but still has his sharp-tongued best friend Young-ha (Kang Ki-young) and his ever-supportive sister Ye-rin (Kim Si-a) by his side. Then one night, Seok-hwan is suddenly attacked by a mysterious stranger and dies on the spot. Miraculously, 72 hours after his death, he opens his eyes again! Seok-hwan learns that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he can come back to life. Before he can figure out what is happening, a mysterious man (Shin Seung-ho) has already set his sights on him. As the mysterious man closes in with relentless pursuit, Seok-hwan gradually discovers that each death makes him stronger. Who wants him dead? And where will this ability — the more he dies, the stronger he becomes — lead him? A desperate fight for survival is about to begin. The film is adapted from the webtoon of the same name.

films.title: 黑牢城
films.synopsis: 天正六年，冬，“本能寺之变”四年前。 荒木村重背叛织田信长，固守在有冈城。织田军围城之下，有冈城内连续发生难以破解的棘手事件，军心动摇，人心惶惶。村重束手无策，多次向地牢中的囚犯黑田官兵卫询问破解之道。一系列事件的背后到底暗藏着什么？织田军的前军师黑田官兵卫又有何图谋？随着战事与推理逐渐展开，村重终于明白……
films.synopsisEn: In the winter of Tensho 6 (1578) — four years before Oda Nobunaga's death at Honno-ji in 1582 — Araki Murashige breaks with Nobunaga and shuts himself inside Arioka Castle. Nobunaga's army surrounds the walls. Inside, a run of unexplained crimes panics the garrison. Out of answers, Murashige keeps turning to the man in his dungeon, Kuroda Kanbei, a former Oda strategist, both for a solution and because he cannot tell what Kanbei wants. Kiyoshi Kurosawa adapted Honobu Yonezawa's novel.

films.title: 奥德赛 The Odyssey
films.synopsis: 改编自同名荷马史诗，讲述奥德修斯（马特·达蒙 饰）的故事，以及他在特洛伊战争后10年的回家之旅。
films.synopsisEn: Adapted from the Homeric epic of the same name, it tells the story of Odysseus (Matt Damon) and his 10-year journey home after the Trojan War.

films.title: 巨蟒博尤纳
films.synopsis: 一支医疗小队深入亚马逊雨林执行任务，可他们很快察觉，此地的生灵并不欢迎外来者。一行人贸然闯入，惊动了丛林掠兽 —— 博尤纳。
films.synopsisEn: A medical team ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest on a mission, but they soon realize that the creatures of this place do not welcome outsiders. Blundering in, the group awakens the jungle predator — the Boiúna.

films.title: 八仙
films.synopsis: “八仙”在成仙和成功之间选择了“成团”，在搞钱和搞事业之间选择了“搞事情”？！吕洞宾、钟离权带队，集结何仙姑、铁拐李、韩湘子、曹国舅、蓝采和与张果老，八个身份各异的凡人因不同机缘稀里糊涂凑在了蓬莱仙境，有人临时起意有人开团秒跟，开起道观过足了“神仙”瘾！面对蓬莱百姓主打一个“有求必应”，草台班子的外壳下却暗藏着“瞒天过海”的胆识。怎料一个惊天阴谋正悄咪咪朝他们砸过来，这场啼笑皆非的奇幻之旅，最终会走向何处呢？ 影片以家喻户晓的传统民间故事“八仙过海”为灵感进行创作。
films.synopsisEn: Eight mismatched mortals — Lü Dongbin, Zhongli Quan, He Xiangu, Iron Crutch Li, Han Xiangzi, Royal Uncle Cao, Lan Caihe, and Zhang Guolao — stumble into the fairy isle of Penglai and decide to live as immortals. They open a Taoist temple and tell the locals every wish will be granted, even though the whole operation is improvised. Under that cheerful scam, a conspiracy is already closing in. The comedy riffs on the folk tale of the Eight Immortals crossing the sea.

films.title: 生化危机
films.synopsis: 故事聚焦奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩（奥斯汀·艾布拉姆斯 饰），意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？
films.synopsisEn: Zach Cregger directs this new Resident Evil story. Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier, is sent into Raccoon City as an outbreak overtakes the streets. What begins as one delivery becomes a night of trying to stay alive among the infected. Cregger co-wrote the script with Shay Hatten.

films.title: 世界的主人
films.synopsis: 开朗的17岁少女珠仁（徐粹彬 饰）因拒绝参与抵制性侵罪犯出狱的校园联名请愿，被迫揭开童年往事。在舆论非议中，她拒绝被标签定义，在破碎家庭、校园风波与内心阴影中完成自我和解与生命重建。一部兼具社会深度与人文温度的青春成长佳作。导演尹佳恩跳出悲情控诉和复仇叙事，以克制细腻的日常镜头呈现创伤幸存者最真实的生存状态——不渲染痛苦、不放大罪恶，只凝视这个少女如何带着伤痕继续前行。片名即宣言：伤痛无法抹去，但人生主导权始终掌握在自己手中。 本片荣获第62届百想艺术大赏电影部门最佳导演及最佳新人女演员奖。
films.synopsisEn: Joo-in (Seo Su-bin), a cheerful 17-year-old girl, is forced to confront a chapter of her childhood when she refuses to sign a school petition against the release of a sex offender. Amid public criticism, she refuses to be defined by labels and finds self-reconciliation and renewal of life as she navigates a broken family, school turmoil and inner shadows. A coming-of-age film that combines social depth with human warmth. Director Yoon Ga-eun moves beyond tragic accusation and revenge narratives, using restrained, delicate everyday camerawork to portray the most authentic state of survival for trauma survivors—neither dramatizing pain nor magnifying evil, but simply watching how this girl keeps moving forward with her scars. The title is a declaration: wounds cannot be erased, but the steering wheel of life always remains in your own hands. The film won Best Director and Best New Actress in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards.

films.title: 入夜不再
films.synopsis: 艾里是一名旅行灵媒，专门帮助清理游荡的灵魂，她只能在镜子倒影中看到已故妹妹的鬼魂。艾里受邀来到一处偏僻的乡间宅邸，屋里有一个面目狰狞的男鬼四处游荡。随着调查深入，艾里发现男鬼受到规则束缚并不致命，而活着的居民却隐藏着可怕的血腥秘密。
films.synopsisEn: Eri is a traveling medium who specializes in clearing out wandering spirits, and can only see the ghost of her deceased sister in mirror reflections. Eri is invited to a remote country house where a hideous male ghost roams. As her investigation deepens, Eri discovers that the male ghost is bound by rules and is not lethal—while the living residents hide a horrifying, bloody secret.

films.title: 另一个妈妈
films.synopsis: 故事讲述八岁女孩贝拉住在父母婚姻摇摇欲坠的房子里。某天，她发现衣柜深处总在深夜探出一个东西——那东西长得和她妈妈乌苏拉一模一样，于是贝拉叫它“另一个妈妈”。它每天重复同一句话：“我可以进到你心里吗？”贝拉本能地拒绝，但“另一个妈妈”开始以更扭曲狰狞的形态渗透家庭生活，甚至试图取代真正的母亲。当家中怪事频发、家人也开始看见它时，贝拉必须在被彻底吞噬前，揪出这个伪装者，或者承认有些门不该打开。 影片改编自乔什·马勒曼2024年的同名小说。
cast: 阿拉贝拉·奥利维娅·克拉克
films.synopsisEn: The story follows eight-year-old Bella, who lives in a house where her parents' marriage is falling apart. One day, she discovers something emerging from deep inside her closet late at night—something that looks exactly like her mother Ursula, so Bella calls it "Other Mommy." Every day it repeats the same question: "Can I go inside your heart?" Bella instinctively refuses, but Other Mommy begins infiltrating family life in ever more twisted and grotesque forms, even trying to replace her real mother. As strange events multiply and her family starts seeing it too, Bella must expose the impostor before being completely consumed—or admit that some doors should never be opened. The film is adapted from Josh Malerman's 2024 novel of the same name.

films.title: 青春共体 The Body +
films.synopsis: 在一次舞蹈队入会仪式出错后，一群行为不端的天主教女校学生开始出现预言性的幻象，并在她们的小镇上引发了大规模歇斯底里。

films.title: 急诊室的奇迹
films.synopsis: 央大医院急诊部副主任周承俊（霍建华 饰）破格录取资质平庸的林耿明（蔡凡熙 饰），与优秀的唐希（詹子萱 饰）、江东彦（彭千祐 饰）一同担任R1住院医师。在资深主治医师何宇华（杨谨华 饰）带领下，这群新手医师随团队穿梭于高压抢救、伦理抉择与院内权力角力之间，在一次次危机中磨合成长，逐渐建立起深刻的信任与情谊。
